note: What a theme's keys part draws, per theme, each choice off a stream of its own (`<seed>::keys:<choice>`): the tone, the space, the motif, the wetness and the whole track's density by these weights; the phrase by its own row's `weight` (phrases.json) among those that fit the theme's key. Tone and space draw independently (the two-voice tones, the electric piano and haze and the felt grand and sine, are left out: two dear voices on one part is 70 units of a 220 ceiling where the drums, the bass and the bed already take up to 145): no pair measured badly in the lab's three rounds, so no compatibility table; his trims after listening go here. `birds` leans a weight by where a bird stands: each named choice's weight is multiplied by exp(lean x strength x (bird - centre)), so a lean of 1 at strength 1 is x0.61 at nought and x1.65 at one, and a bird at the centre leaves the weights as written. Modest on purpose: a lean moves a draw, it never decides it. Revision 2 (liquid-keys-2, his word 10-29: "all liquid dnb tracks now very similar", the keys first): what never reached the draw comes in at lower weights, for his ear to trim (his method of 10-11: the variety in, then the bad mixes out, about 80 % good): four tones the lab tested (the dark upright and the muted upright, both on the new piano string; the reed electric piano; the mellow grand), the three spaces of the lab's that were left out (the dark long hall and the two with an echo, the ping-pong quarter and the dotted quarter), the phrases of three and four chords (their weights on their rows, marked `widens`) and the comp, how a landing is struck (`comps.json`).

rows.name: The tested liquid keys
rows.says: The variety the keys lab tested and he found mostly fine (10-11): every round-3 phrase and, less often, the lab's longer progressions written sparse, the warm pianos and electric pianos and, less often, the dark and muted uprights, the reed electric piano and the mellow grand, his four spaces, the three very wet ones and, less often, the dark hall and two echoes, three motif grammars and no motif rarely, the three wetness steps, the three whole-track densities and three comps, held most.

more.says: The newcomers of revision 2, weighed as if they stood in the lists above, drawn so the lists above draw as they did: a theme first rolls, off a stream of its own (`<seed>::keys:<choice>:more`), whether its choice is a newcomer, at the newcomers' share of the whole (both leaned by the birds), and only then draws among them; otherwise it draws among the lists above off the stream it always did.

tide.says: Tide, space and distance: toward the wetter steps and the longer, wider spaces

zephyr.says: Zephyr, brightness and air: toward the electric pianos and the brighter returns, away from the far, dark grand and the low-passed wash

gleam.says: Gleam, harmonic light: toward the warmer phrases, away from the dark ones

loom.says: Loom, the phrase's length: toward the sparser densities
